scope: Read-only evidence audit of 19 selected local_trial_only entries; audit artifacts only. No new runtime tests or visual approvals.
authorization_scope: Latest request authorizes resolving/testing release blockers; it is not a new human visual/keeper/publication approval.

promotion_contract.note: A boolean validator is not a specification of exhaustive terrain, walking, performance or accessibility certification. The next-test matrix below is a concrete proposed bounded interpretation of its eight names; do not expand historical evidence scopes.

status_definitions.supported_historical: Inspected exact-candidate evidence supports this bounded past check; reconciliation possible without a new live test. Not a fresh deployment pass.
status_definitions.partial: Some relevant evidence exists, but the required check is incomplete or scope ambiguous.
status_definitions.not_tested: No sufficient live check found in inspected evidence. This is not a claim that no evidence exists anywhere.

minimum_test_matrix.catalogue_card: Search the exact candidate in the normal catalogue; verify label, photographic reference hero and successful selection. Save a screenshot and selected identity.
minimum_test_matrix.exact_variant: Place it once; record candidate/variant, mounted revision and downloaded GLB SHA-256 against this audit. Compare visible silhouette with the locked reference and retain mounted native scale.
minimum_test_matrix.ground_contact: On a disposable prepared-level site, inspect the complete envelope at low and oblique views, including projecting steps/porches; retain ground-support diagnostics and screenshots. This establishes prepared-site scope only.
minimum_test_matrix.small_and_large_plot: On a vacant site large enough for the candidate, place at picker minimum width/depth and enlarge to the supported maximum. Verify complete unchanged native geometry and identity at both sizes. Record dimensions, scale and screenshots; also record clean rejection below the supported minimum without replacing the saved model.
minimum_test_matrix.rotation: Rotate the selected native model by 15 degrees through ordinary controls; verify model and plot rotate together with unchanged scale and supported ground contact. Record before/after and persisted rotation.
minimum_test_matrix.save_reload: Save after the size and rotation edits; cold-reload/reopen the project and compare candidate, exact revision, transform and footprint. Record the saved binding and mounted model SHA.
minimum_test_matrix.close_and_occluded_capture: Create a free exact 3D capture of the model close up and a second with partial foreground occlusion. Complete both downloads, open the files, and compare framing, visible model identity and silhouette with their same-camera scene views. Record paths/hashes and screenshot evidence; preview alone is insufficient.
minimum_test_matrix.no_console_errors: Capture browser console and failed application requests across selection, placement, both size cases, rotation, save/reload and captures; explain unrelated environmental messages and retain zero unexplained application errors.

execution_plan: Reconcile only supported historical checks with exact SHA, project, date, tester and evidence. Preserve superseded failures with explicit links.

Run one browser session per candidate in a disposable prepared-level site sized for its maximum plot. Cover all remaining checks; reuse placement across minimum/maximum, rotation, reload and capture steps.
Retain mounted/downloaded model SHA, saved binding and evidence file hashes. Console collection spans the complete session. No paid image generation is needed.
Stop after the bounded 19-candidate matrix. Re-evaluate remaining failures without marking unrun checks passed. Human activation remains separate.
broader_gates_not_independent_promotion_: Natural/sloped/exposed-edge terrain beyond claimed prepared-site support
Complete walking routes, all entrances, upper floors and street-to-door continuity (still relevant to the user walking requirement)
Accessibility design, touch input and multi-entrance recovery
Fresh empty DB/bucket install (separate hosted-release workstream)
Human visual/keeper approval and publication authorization (separate activation requirement)
